summary: Frontend-only retest of the 'black homepage' fix on the Emergent preview URL (not Netlify). At 390px and 1920px the homepage now shows real content above the footer: home-hero with the owner's uploaded banner (title 'Hero banner', Supabase webp loaded, naturalWidth 800), home-section-story (with /demo/story.jpg loaded), home-section-care and home-section-newsletter. home-page height is about 2200-2300px, so it is not just header + footer. Categories and new-arrivals sections are correctly hidden because the DB has 0 categories and 0 products. Footer Help links are title-cased (Shipping, Returns & refunds, Cancellation, Jewellery care, FAQ, Privacy policy, Terms). Announcement 'Site is not live yet' is an <a href='https://www.instagram.com/iminationz' target='_blank'>. /pages/contact shows only Email and Phone, with no Hours row. /pages/faq shows its fallback text. No console errors or page errors. No accounts, newsletter signups or orders were created.

issues: The default fallback body '[Your brand story — a few lines on how IMINATIONZ began.]' (bracketed placeholder) is shown to live visitors because homepage_content is empty. Consider a customer-ready default or hiding the body when it is a placeholder.
Hero title 'Hero banner' and subtitle 'Hshsvsgsh' are the owner's own placeholder data, not a code bug. The owner should edit the banner in admin.
The hero image is only 800px wide but is shown in a ~765px-wide half at 1920px and full-bleed on large screens. A higher-resolution upload is recommended.

action_items: Optional: replace the bracketed placeholder story body in DEFAULT_SECTIONS (lib/defaults.js) with customer-ready copy, or hide it
Remind the user that Netlify must be redeployed with the current build. izlive.netlify.app was not tested.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js: the fallback to DEFAULT_SECTIONS only applies when sections.length === 0. If the owner saves rows that are all is_visible=false, the page will again render only header + footer.
Contact page and footer filter out falsy values correctly, so empty hours/address do not render.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live Supabase DB: 1 hero banner, 0 homepage_content, 0 categories, 0 products. Expect hero/story/care/newsletter only. Do not submit forms (live customer DB).
